approach_selection.no_positive_lower_bound: list is EXPLORATORY and the highest point estimate is submitted with that stated
approach_selection.rule: highest split-half lower bound; within 0.05 choose by out-of-time lower bound, then inclusion concentration, then explainability, then id order A, B, C

combination.rule: combine when the cross-format lower 95% bound is at least 0.3 and at least 30 players have both formats; otherwise show per-format results and flag the combination as unsupported; no fixed format weights

evidence_classes.INCONSISTENT: share of positive units below 0.5, or dispersion above the cohort 75th percentile with a positive mean
evidence_classes.STRONG_LIMITED: above the cohort 80th percentile with an interval including 0, or matches between 1x and 2x the floor
evidence_classes.STRONG_SUBSTANTIAL: interval lower bound above 0, matches at least 2x the floor, positive share at least 0.5

candidates.P1: leverage: expected absolute win-probability swing of the next ball (chunk 2)
candidates.P3: chase difficulty from the required-rate gap, resource ratio (innings 2 only)
candidates.P4: resource scarcity: wickets lost share x innings progress (both innings)
candidates.P5: defending difficulty from the batting side's gap and wickets (innings 2 only)
candidates.P6: first principal component of the standardised passing candidates

intensity.innings1_rule: P3 and P5 are innings-2 only; innings 1 uses the best-passing both-innings candidate (P4, then P6); otherwise innings-1 deliveries are excluded
intensity.pass_rule: tests a, b, e hold pooled on TRAIN, the same signs hold on VALIDATION and the candidate passes in at least 2 of 3 phases
intensity.primary_choice: most passed tests among a-e, then widest innings coverage, then id
intensity.scale: empirical CDF of the raw value fitted on TRAIN, mapped to [0, 1]

validity_tests.a: runs per ball lower in decile 10 than decile 1 beyond the bootstrap half-width
validity_tests.b: wicket probability higher in decile 10 than decile 1
validity_tests.c: variance of runs per ball higher in decile 10 than decile 1
validity_tests.d: mean absolute win-probability change larger (mechanical for P1 and P2)
validity_tests.e: Spearman trend across deciles at least 0.7 for tests a and b
validity_tests.g: cells with fewer than 2000 deliveries are NOT_ESTIMABLE

models.features: pre-delivery state only; no player identifier, no outcome column
models.selection: one pass on VALIDATION: log loss for classifiers, RMSE for regressors

ranking.order: descending estimate of the chosen approach; unshrunk when the floor binds

reliability.icc: one-way random-effects ICC(1) of unit means, units with at least 2 matches
reliability.phase6_gate_note: reported unchanged and never used as a label input
reliability.split_half: match parity (odd/even by date) and time (early/late) on unshrunk precision-weighted unit means; Spearman-Brown 2r/(1+r); Fisher-z pooling

reml.floor_ordering: unshrunk precision-weighted mean; status forced to EXPLORATORY
reml.tau2_floor: none imposed; tau2 below 1e-8 sigma2 is flagged FLOOR

scope: IPL and T20I, PRE_TEST window (TRAIN + VALIDATION); TEST is never loaded; batters and bowlers are analysed separately and never compared with each other
sources: official IPL and T20I data only; matches 2026.csv and *_stats2026.csv unused

splits.fit_population: TRAIN only; VALIDATION is scored out of sample
splits.fold_rule: match_id % 5, deterministic; no match is in two partitions or folds
splits.test: never opened; the Phase 4 TEST aggregates are previously accessed and non-pristine

status_thresholds.EXPLORATORY: an ordered list exists but PROVISIONAL is not met
status_thresholds.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: fewer than ten eligible players or the approach cannot be computed
status_thresholds.floor_rule: a between-player variance at the floor forces EXPLORATORY with the unshrunk ordering
